goal: Implement draggable, focusable, stacked application windows.
summary: Window Manager phase complete. Delivered WindowContext with reducer, draggable Window component, WindowManager, and Dock→Window wiring integrated into App.jsx. 160/160 tests pass, lint clean, build succeeds.
stepSummaries:
1. Define the window state shape {id, appId, x, y, width, height, minimized, zIndex} and a reducer handling OPEN, CLOSE, MINIMIZE, FOCUS, DRAG, RESIZE, RESTORE. [verified]
  2. Implement the Window component with a draggable title bar, close/minimize/fullscreen buttons, pointer-event drag logic, and focus-on-click. [verified]
  3. Implement WindowManager to render all non-minimized windows, assign z-index via a monotonic counter on FOCUS, and forward active-app changes to the shell. [verified]
  4. Wire Dock open/close actions to the WindowContext and ensure opening an already-open app focuses it. [verified]
